passage.ro: Last summer my family went to the seaside for a week. We travelled by train and the journey took six hours. The hotel was near the beach, so we went swimming every morning. One day my brother found a big shell and gave it to my mother. In the afternoon we visited an old lighthouse and climbed one hundred steps to the top. The view was fantastic! On the last evening we ate fish in a small restaurant and watched the sunset. I did not want to go home, but my school started the next week, so we left on Saturday.

passage.ro: Yesterday our class went to the zoo. The bus left school at nine o'clock and we arrived at ten. First we saw the monkeys. They were very funny, and one of them stole a boy's hat! Then we watched the lions. They were sleeping under a tree, so we did not see much. At twelve o'clock we had a picnic near the lake. After lunch, our teacher, Mrs Pop, took us to the elephants. A baby elephant was playing with water and everybody laughed. We came back to school at four o'clock and we were all very tired but happy.

passage.ro: My grandmother lives in a small village in the mountains. I usually visit her in August. When I was little, I went there with my cousins, and we played in the river all day. Now I help my grandmother in the garden. She grows tomatoes, beans and flowers. Every morning she makes fresh bread in an old oven, and the whole house smells wonderful. In the evening we sit in front of the house and she tells me stories about her childhood. She says that long ago there was no electricity in the village. I love these summer holidays because everything is calm and beautiful.

passage.ro: Last Friday was Sports Day at our school. It was sunny and warm, so we had the competitions outside. First there was a running race. Andrei was the fastest and he won a small gold medal. Then the girls played volleyball. My team was losing at first, but we played better in the second part and we won by two points! After that, the teachers played football against the older pupils. The teachers lost, but they were laughing all the time. At the end the headteacher gave prizes to everybody. I was very proud of our class.

passage.ro: Last Sunday it was raining all day, so I stayed at home. At ten o'clock I was reading a book in my room when my little sister came in. She was holding a box of old photographs. We sat on the floor and looked at them together. There was a photo of our parents at a wedding and another one of our grandfather with his first car. While we were laughing at the funny clothes, my mum brought us hot chocolate. In the afternoon we made a pizza and watched a film. It was a lovely day, even without any sunshine.
